claims.claim: One SQLite authority can serialize a source challenge and a local send reservation so an earlier unresolved challenge prevents reservation.
claims.falsifier: An accepted reservation with an earlier committed unresolved ancestor challenge in the same DB.

claims.claim: A crash after send reservation is conservatively recovered as UNKNOWN, not automatically re-sent.
claims.falsifier: A restart automatically reserves/sends the same effect ID again.

claims.claim: An idempotent simulated provider lets an uncertain committed result be reconciled without creating a second effect.
claims.falsifier: More than one simulated effect record from repeated identical requests for one key.

claims.claim: HMAC-authenticated provider records are required for acknowledgement in the local lab.
claims.falsifier: A forged or action-mismatched receipt marks an effect SUCCEEDED.

claims.claim: Local audit-state crosschecking refuses simple materialized-table rewinds even when hash chain rows are unchanged.
claims.falsifier: Reset effect and outbox state after SEND_RESERVED, preserve audit, and reserve again.

claims.claim: Same-DB crash safety does not prevent a direct external provider write or a challenge accepted by another unrelayed store.
claims.falsifier: The toy provider refuses a direct write or this authority observes an external challenge without relay.

claims.claim: Trusted false evidence may still authorize an incorrect effect despite correct cryptography and policy checks.
claims.falsifier: The reference system identifies false real-world eligibility without a separate truthful source.

claims.claim: An effect reserved before a challenge remains potentially executable afterward.
claims.falsifier: A challenge retroactively prevents the simulated provider from acting on an already reserved command without provider-side enforcement.
